notes.subject: יזרבו
notes.rationale: Root meaning uncertain: 'to be warm' (hence streams dry up) vs 'to flow away'; KJV 'wax warm' follows the heat sense.

notes.subject: נצמתו / נדעכו
notes.rationale: Two near-synonymous extinction verbs in parallel, both with -ו endings — the doubling of vanishing is the rhetoric.

translation: Long taim ol i kamap hat, ol i lus; long hat bilong em, ol i pundaun, ol i go ausait long ples bilong ol.

tokens.gloss: ol i kamap hat na ol i lus
